slides.text: At exactly 9:03 AM, my phone buzzed. Someone had added me to a group chat called 'Today's Departures.' There were 247 members. Before I could leave, messages flooded in. 'Anyone know what a falling piano feels like?' 'Flight 281 people, you all here?' Then an admin named 'Death' typed, 'Good morning everyone. Please remain calm.'

Chaos erupted instantly. One guy kept demanding refunds because he'd just renewed his gym membership. Someone else begged for spoilers about the afterlife. Death ignored everyone and posted a spreadsheet. 'Please verify your scheduled cause of death. Last week's typo resulted in three unnecessary hauntings. We apologize for the inconvenience.' The reactions only got worse.

Just as I accepted my fate, Death tagged me personally. 'Rohan, administrative error. You're supposed to be in tomorrow's group. Sorry about that.' I vanished from the chat. Five seconds later my phone buzzed again. 'Tomorrow's Departures (248 Members).' The first message read, 'Hey, is anyone else here because of a clerical mistake?'
